answer: Use SybilGuard random routes to cap fake identities. Each agent precommits a walk of signed neighbor hops and later opens a cipher of that path so peers can test intersections without seeing every edge. An honest walk wanders like a river from one social terrace to another and almost never shares an early hop, while keys run by one operator collide on the same bottleneck. Those collisions mark the farm, and only unflagged routes keep earning rights.
